 Zhang Shuai offers great value at +120 to cover +3.5 games against Tereza Valentova, who will play her first match since returning from a hip injury.
 Current Form:
 Tereza Valentova will be playing her first match in Asia this year after taking a lengthy layoff to recover from a hip injury. Valentova reached the final of her last tournament at Philadelphia WTA 125. However, a hip injury she suffered in a 3-6, 5-7 loss to Katie Volynets caused her to miss the US Open and two WTA 1000 events in China.
 Zhang Shuai suffered a lopsided loss to Ashlyn Krueger 3-6, 0-6, in the first round of the 2026 Wuhan Open. Ranked 85th in the world, Zhang carries an 11-14 record on hard courts and a 22-27 record overall in 2026.
 The Matchup: Valentova will play Zhang for the first time on the WTA Tour.

 Our Tereza Valentova vs Shuai Zhang Prediction
 The Difference Maker: When healthy, Tereza Valentova should easily handle Zhang Shuai’s craftiness and experience. Unfortunately, the status of Valentova’s injury remains unclear, and this could open a window of opportunity for Zhang to gain some ground or perhaps pull off an upset.
 What to Expect: Valentova could grind out a win, but she’s not blowing out Zhang, who always possesses the ability to rack up break point conversions with an elite return game. If Valentova cannot land 60 percent of her first serves, she will find herself in trouble against Zhang, who wins 56 percent of her opponents’ second serves on hard courts.
